terms.metaAciklama: The terms of use for LucidMove's membership and video service.
terms.uyari: This text is a general template; we recommend consulting a legal advisor for the obligations specific to your business.
terms.s1Metin: These Terms of Use govern the use of the monthly or yearly membership-based yoga video service offered through LucidMove ("the Platform"). Anyone who registers for or uses the Platform ("Member") is deemed to have accepted these terms.
terms.s2Metin: LucidMove is a video library that gives an active member unlimited access to yoga classes created by a single instructor. Some lessons may be offered for free as an introduction.
terms.s3Metin: Membership fees are collected through the secure Iyzico payment infrastructure, according to the plan selected (monthly or yearly). Your card details are never stored on the Platform's servers. Prices may be updated by {marka}; current prices are always shown on the membership page.
terms.s4Metin: You can cancel your membership at any time from your account page. Cancelling stops the renewal charge for the next period; your access continues until the end of the period you've already paid for. Partial refunds are not issued.
terms.s5Metin: Video content is for personal, non-commercial use only. Downloading, copying, recording, reproducing, or sharing the videos with third parties is prohibited.
terms.s6Metin: All video, text, imagery, and brand elements on the Platform belong to LucidMove or the relevant rights holders and may not be reproduced or distributed without prior written permission.
terms.s7Metin: The classes are general exercise content and do not constitute medical advice. If you have any health concerns, we recommend consulting a healthcare professional before starting. The Platform does not guarantee the service will be uninterrupted or error-free.
terms.s8Metin: These terms may be updated from time to time. Significant changes will be announced on the Platform; continuing to use the service means you accept the current terms.
terms.s9Metin: For questions, you can reach us at {eposta}.

privacy.metaAciklama: LucidMove's privacy policy on the processing of personal data.
privacy.uyari: This text is a general template; we recommend consulting a legal advisor for your obligations under Turkey's Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("KVKK").
privacy.s1Metin: When you create a membership, we collect your full name, email address, and password (stored encrypted). When you purchase a membership, payment is processed through Iyzico; your card details never reach the Platform's servers. You may optionally upload a profile photo from your account page. Your video-watching activity may be recorded to help us improve the service.
privacy.s2Metin: The data we collect is processed to carry out membership and payment processes, provide access to your account, respond to your support requests, and fulfil our legal obligations.
privacy.s3Metin: Your password is stored using irreversible encryption. Your data is retained only for as long as necessary to provide the service and is protected with reasonable security measures.
privacy.s4Metin: Your payment details are shared with Iyzico solely to process payment. Your data is not shared with or sold to third parties for marketing purposes, except where required by law.
privacy.s5Metin: The Platform uses essential cookies to keep you signed in. Membership features do not work without these cookies.
privacy.s6Metin: Under KVKK, you have the right to learn whether your data is being processed, and to request its correction or deletion. You can exercise these rights by contacting {eposta}. You can edit your account and profile details directly from your account page.
privacy.s7Metin: For privacy questions, you can reach us at {eposta}.
